svg.title: Maknae egress and tool execution
svg.desc: UML component view of how a subject's tools reach sites and Vault through maknae-proxy, how model calls reach providers through maknae-egress, and which process decides, enforces or carries each hop. Solid is built; dashed is proposed.
svg.text: Egress and tool execution — who decides, who enforces, who carries each hop
UML 2.5.1 component view. Solid lines and borders are built today; dashed are proposed by a design concept, design/egress-and-tool-execution.md, which is not authoritative.
Dashing alone marks status. A person and an Agent Daemon use the same path; their tier's policy differs (§3), not the mechanism.
Subject side · subject or workspace uids
each process under its own service account
applies the envelope; trusted for an agent's task
git · gh · glab · cargo · vault · ssh …
own credential via a plug-in point
no seal key, Vault identity or subject credential
decides which paths a token may read
The person's TUI asks maknaed for each verb: fs.read, fs.write and
session.prompt today; tool invocations under this design.
The Agent Daemon asks maknaed over its own plane certificate, mutual TLS
After a permit, the loop hands the invocation to the launcher; a trusted
launcher takes the run-as uid from maknaed, not the loop.
The launcher starts the host's own tool as the subject (for an agent's task, the
tasker's workspace uid), inside the envelope, with HTTPS_PROXY set.
The tool's connections go to maknae-proxy (HTTP CONNECT, with the proxy
identity): by default, and as their only network path where §7 enforces.
maknae-proxy asks maknaed, per connection, whether this subject may reach this
site; maknaed decides and records it.
A permitted connection is tunnelled byte for byte; TLS stays end to end, and the
Where the network requires it, maknae-proxy chains to the network's proxy,
stamping each CONNECT with who is acting (Forwarded, Via, subject).
Subjects' Vault traffic (loops and tools; the loops' path is not drawn) goes
through maknae-proxy, never chained upstream (§10 item 1).
The trust plane calls Vault directly: maknaed for its own AppRole and plane
A model turn: maknaed decides session.prompt and hands maknae-egress the sealed
maknae-egress makes the one model call with the subject's key and zeroizes it.
maknae-egress checks and unwraps the subject's single-use wrapping token with
Built today: the maknae CLI and TUI call Vault directly (login, certificate,
wrapped reads). Under this design that traffic moves to 9.
Proposed (#168 slice 4): at intake, maknae-egress asks the site for the tasker's
and the agent's access; who mints the task token is open (§10 item 13).
Where Maknae holds the SSH credential: maknae-ssh, deciding each operation with
maknaed; a sealed key or a Vault SSH certificate (#456).
